condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

MCA-N and MCC have made a determination to proceed with construction of the V-G Road, based on satisfactory review by MCC of a Satisfied final feasibility and design study and an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) (including Environmental Management Plan (EMP) and, as needed, a Resettlement Action Plan (RAP).
MCA-N provides evidence of continued compliance, satisfactory to MCC, with the EMP.

MCA-N provides evidence that any required RAP, including full payment of resettlement costs, has been implemented on each applicable road segment of the V-G Road in accordance with World Bank operational policy on involuntary resettlement and in a manner acceptable to MCC.

MCA-N provides evidence that the economic analysis of the design chosen by the Government for the V-G Road Project Activity shows an economic rate of return based on standard HDM-type models that exceeds MCC's threshold as stated in Schedule 2 to Annex I of the Compact, and that such analysis meets the standards set by MCC.
MCA-N submits to MCC a copy of a report on file with MCA-N, acceptable to MCC, verifying that all M&E baseline data has been gathered for the V-G Road.
